title: Maintenance
description: Every car's services, repairs and checks

help.title: About maintenance
help.overview: Each car's service book. The latest completed record sets the car's next service date and km.

sections.title: On this page
items: Scheduled and cancelled records don't count towards the next service.
Chosen staff are notified 14 days or 1,000 km before the next service is due.
A higher odometer reading on a record moves the car's odometer forward.
